description: This line plot illustrates the reliability scores of three different models—labeled “3-Model Ensemble,” “2-Model Ensemble,” and “GPT-4”—as a function of cost, with cost plotted on the x-axis ranging from 0 to 10 in linear increments and reliability score on the y-axis ranging from 30 to 90 in linear increments. The “3-Model Ensemble” is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at a reliability score of approximately 82 at a cost of 0 and decreasing to about 74 at a cost of 10. The “2-Model Ensemble” is shown as a solid red line with circular markers, beginning at a reliability score of approximately 85 at cost 0 and declining to about 73 at cost 10. The “GPT-4” model is depicted by a solid gold line with circular markers, starting at a reliability score of 90 at cost 0 and sharply decreasing to approximately 40 at cost 10. All three lines show a general downward trend as cost increases, with GPT-4 experiencing the steepest decline in reliability score.
